identity: IDs are local to (profile, native spec SHA256, local ID); closed fictional registry; no external codes, aliases or input overrides
rational: exact int numerator and positive exact int denominator; abs(n).bit_length() and d.bit_length() <= 63; bool/float/string rejected; retain unreduced input, return reduced fractions
domain: point or finite nonempty real interval; rational bounds, explicit bool endpoint inclusion; equal endpoints require both closed; converted_domain is {lower,upper,lower_closed,upper_closed} even for points
uncertainty: mandatory {kind:not_evaluated}; any other named kind is unsupported_uncertainty, never zero uncertainty or a statistical interval
gates: validate whole request first; operand unknown capability > unknown kind/unit > query dimension mismatch > compare kind mismatch > compute; same-reference equality never bypasses gates; unused unknown literals retained without blocking unrelated queries
relations: distinct references quantify the Cartesian product of domains; ordered less,equal,greater; same reference denotes one shared value and returns equal; singleton certain_relation only; no probability independence claim
conversion: positive exact source scale / target scale; endpoints and inclusion preserved; no affine/logarithmic or inter-kind conversion, rounding, parsing, clinical inference or base-state reads/writes
output: retain original quantities and origins; computed rows publish values and calculation_evidence atomically; other rows have null converted_domain, relation_set, certain_relation, calculation_evidence; clinical_confirmation=not_evaluated, uncertainty_propagated=false, converted_to_base=false, clinical_assertions_added=[]; certificate never certified
steps: 1 request start + N_quantities + 6 per convert + 9 per compare; sorted query IDs; prepay entire row before calculation and publication including stopped semantic rows; shared budget, no alias/point discount
bounds: unit scale numerator/denominator <=7 bits; canonical endpoints <=70 bits, converted <=77 bits, comparison cross products <=140 bits, below 256; budget meters fixed bounded work, not machine instructions

errors.invalid_rational: invalid_input: malformed rational, bool/non-int components or denominator <=0
errors.invalid_interval: invalid_input: inverted or empty interval, non-bool inclusion
errors.input_dimension_mismatch: invalid_input: known input kind and unit dimensions differ
errors.unsupported_magnitude: unsupported_profile: named magnitude variant outside point/interval
errors.unsupported_uncertainty: unsupported_profile: named uncertainty other than not_evaluated
errors.unsupported_query_kind: unsupported_profile: named query kind outside convert/compare

scope: literal mathematics only; no ledger or clinical adoption, no claims of measurement equality, universal unit support, persistent identity, or clinical equivalence; R2-3 base-state monotonicity is vacuous because no base state is read
